title: A New Lord of the Rings Movie Is Still Being Made
summary:
Lord of the Rings fans can relax. A new movie made with TV host Stephen Colbert is still being worked on, Polygon reports.

On October 4, a website said the movie was "paused" because two big movie companies, Paramount and Warner Bros., joined together. But the website did not say where it got that news. On October 5, a writer from Screen Rant called the report "inaccurate." Warner Bros. also said the movie is "not 'canceled' and is still in development."

The movie may be called The Lord of the Rings: Shadows of the Past. Director Peter Jackson announced it in March 2026. Colbert is a big fan of author J.R.R. Tolkien.

In the story, the hobbits Sam, Merry and Pippin retrace their old adventure 14 years after Frodo has passed on. Sam's daughter, Elanor, discovers a secret.

Another movie, The Hunt for Gollum, comes out on December 17, 2027.
why_it_matters: It reminds readers to check where news comes from before believing a rumor.
